ownership: Test-specific forms are agent-owned evaluation criteria; not requester-owned hard semantic obligations. They are fixed before retrieval and render.
scoring: All required gates must PASS in the same original output; FAIL or UNOBSERVABLE is whole_scene FAIL; partial_is_fail.
actor_coordinates: For nearly frontal head: actor right is screen left; actor left is screen right. Explicit ownership beats screen placement.

gates.expected: single explicitly adult-looking subject in dry street clothing at recognizable indoor public-pool lost-property counter; guide and different-oriented wall arrow both visible
gates.fail: missing desk/guide/arrow relation or replacement by glamour/swimwear scene

gates.expected: both eyes visibly open with iris/pupil visible; subject-left upper lid covers more of iris than subject-right by observable margin
gates.fail: equal fully open eyes, complete wink, closed eyes, squint dominated by lower lids
gates.unobservable: blur, occlusion, too small, head angle preventing comparison

gates.expected: pupils/irises shifted toward subject-right relative to near frontal head
gates.fail: gaze straight into lens or in opposite direction; head turn substituted for iris shift
gates.unobservable: eye detail cannot locate irises reliably

gates.expected: a narrow central inter-lip opening exposes a thin upper-incisor edge while subject-left corner is a little higher than right
gates.fail: fully closed lips, broad grin, wide open mouth, symmetric corners, glossy highlight alone mistaken as a gap/tooth
gates.unobservable: resolution/occlusion prevents separation of tooth and highlight or corner height

gates.expected: right index fingertip in direct visible contact with own right lower cheek beside mouth; local indentation/displacement supports contact
gates.fail: hovering finger, contact with lips/chin instead, other hand, finger merely overlaps silhouette
gates.unobservable: contact point hidden or too soft to resolve

gates.expected: left index fingertip near own left temple, separated by visible 4-6cm air gap; ownership clear
gates.fail: touches temple/hair/face, detached hand ownership ambiguous, gap absent or hand missing
gates.unobservable: cropped finger/temple or depth alignment hiding gap

gates.expected: attached image used only for visible face and hair appearance; resulting subject remains expressly adult in request and final scene
gates.fail: reference replaced by unrelated face/hair, added inferred identity/character/body proportion
gates.unobservable: likeness cannot be established from output/ref comparison

gates.expected: all required gates pass in the same original generated image
gates.fail: any FAIL or UNOBSERVABLE in required gates; partial_is_fail
